name: club.atlasyield/mcp
title: AtlasYield
description: DeFi vault judgment for agents: 16-factor Atlas Score, route survival, blowup alerts. Read-only.

tools.name: find_vaults
tools.description: Start here when you do not already have a vault address. Answers "which vaults for this asset on this chain?": returns a short ranked list (default 5, max 10) of scored vaults with composite, label, live APY/TVL, risk flags (thin_tvl, apy_outlier, no_yield, ...), whether a deposit can reach it (routable), and a citable page URL. It also returns what the filters REMOVED: counts per filter, the best-ranked dropped vaults with reasons, near-miss asset symbols, and whether more matched than were returned. Vaults with no deposit route and rows scored on fallback data are excluded. Ranked by the chosen metric, a ranking and not a recommendation. A flag is a caution, not a verdict, and no flag does not mean safe. Take a chosen vaultId/address to check_route_survival before any deposit. Read-only.

asset.description: Underlying asset symbol, or a list of up to 10, e.g. USDC or ["USDC","USDT0"]. Exact match: USDC does not include syrupUSDC (similarAssets lists near misses)

chain.description: Chain name (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, bnb, solana) or EVM chain id

protocolId.description: Protocol slug, e.g. morpho, aave-v3, pendle

minApy.description: Minimum live APY in percentage points, e.g. 10 for 10%

sortBy.description: Rank by this, descending. Default composite

tools.name: get_vault_score
tools.description: Latest Atlas Score for one vault: composite (0-100), label, the four pillar scores (yield, safety, liquidity, sustainability), live APY/TVL, data quality and the scoring timestamp. Each vault also carries holdingsScore: the score from what it holds, with its cap; published:false means it is not yet the headline composite. notYieldProduct: true means it earns essentially nothing; do not present the score as a reason to deposit for yield. Returns found:false when the vault is not in the scored universe. Read-only.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What the Atlas Score Index covers right now: number of scored vaults, total TVL, composite score spread, and counts by protocol and chain. Use it before asking about a vault to learn whether a protocol or chain is in the scored universe at all. Read-only.

protocolId.description: Restrict to one protocol id, e.g. morpho, aave-v3, pendle, beefy, yearn-v3, euler

tools.name: check_route_survival
tools.description: Can a deposit into this vault be exited at size, measured today? Returns the daily round-trip route screen (USDC -> position -> USDC): verdict, USD in/out, fraction retained, the path probed, and when. blocking:true means refuse the deposit (NO_ROUTE, DANGEROUS, UNPRICEABLE). reasonClass says why: protocol_refused (the protocol's own router refuses, the vault is dead) vs no_aggregator_quote (no same-chain swap into the underlying, common for LP vaults; redeeming by hand may still work). The probe is SAME-CHAIN only: USDC on the vault's own chain. It says nothing about bridging in from elsewhere. Route tracking covers EVM chains only: a Solana vault returns tracked:false (not tracked, neither a pass nor a failure). A vault that was never screened returns screened:false with no verdict — never a fabricated one. Call this BEFORE moving money. Read-only.

chainId.description: EVM chain id of the vault

tools.name: list_open_alerts
tools.description: Open blowup-monitor alerts from the published daily snapshot: score-band exits, fast composite breaks, yield collapse, TVL flight, exploit flags, delistings. Each event carries score before/after and pillar deltas. Published once a day; the date field says when. Read-only.

minSeverity.description: Only alerts at or above this severity (1 = lowest)

tools.name: explain_vault_score
tools.description: Why a vault has its Atlas Score: all 16 factors (15 additive across four pillars + the multiplicative exploit-history modifier), each with sub-score (0-100), weight, raw input and a plain-English label, grouped by pillar, plus the three weakest factors. Exactly what the engine computed at scoredAt, not a recomputation. Returns found:false when unscored. Read-only.

tools.name: compare_vaults
tools.description: Side-by-side Atlas Scores for 2-8 vaults: composite, label, four pillars, live APY/TVL, data quality, yieldQuality and exitSafety, with a ranking by composite, vaults flagged notYieldProduct ranked after the others (each entry also has notYieldProduct: true when the vault earns about nothing; null when the API does not report it). Unscored vaults come back found:false rather than silently dropped. Read-only.

vaults.description: 2-8 vaults to compare, any mix of chains

tools.name: get_wallet_positions
tools.description: What an EVM wallet already holds across the AtlasYield catalog, and how each holding is scored. Reads the balance of every catalog vault on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and BNB. positions: scored holdings with composite, pillar scores, yield quality, exit safety, routability and any open blowup-monitor alerts. unscored: catalog vaults held that carry no score (no Atlas number is given for them). valueUsd is an estimate. complete:false means a chain could not be read: treat that chain as unknown, never as empty. Solana (Kamino) is not read. Read-only.
